description: This file defines a serializer codec for the System.Type class in the Orleans.Serialization framework. It provides methods to write and read Type instances to/from a byte stream, handling various schema types such as well-known, referenced, and encoded types. The class implements IFieldCodec<Type> and handles serialization logic, including reference management and type metadata encoding.

classes.name: TypeSerializerCodec
classes.description: A serializer for the System.Type type, capable of writing and reading Type objects in a custom binary format within the Orleans.Serialization framework.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a Type object to the writer, including type metadata (well-known, referenced, or encoded).

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a Type object from the reader, reconstructing the Type based on schema information in the stream.
